items.title: Barry Kernfeld interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 16, 2020
items.q: Hendrix was a real exception at the time.

ctx.x: That’s awesome. Did you distinguish at that time between white musicians in rock and black musicians in rock? Was there anything that made them different from one another?
At that time there were almost no black musicians in rock. So no, there wasn’t a distinction to be made. Hendrix was a real exception at the time. It was very, very much white music.
